en: Choose between the Default and Project 4K experience.
zh: 选择默认体验或 Project 4K 体验。
不包含开发工具的 Project 4K 界面。

en: Toggle if a confirmation is shown when using the "Reload Window" button.
zh: 设置使用“重新加载窗口”按钮时是否显示确认提示。

en: Continue "Explain and Fix" actions in the current conversation instead of starting a new one.
zh: 在当前对话中继续“解释并修复”操作。

en: Slightly modify your UI to ensure more consistent demos. This is only recommended for demo purposes. In most cases, you can run "Antigravity: Start Demo Mode" and "Antigravity: Stop Demo Mode" to control this switch and update your ~/.gemini/antigravity data directory.
zh: 调整界面以保持演示一致性，建议仅在演示时使用。通常可运行“Antigravity: Start Demo Mode”和“Antigravity: Stop Demo Mode”控制此开关并更新 ~/.gemini/antigravity 数据目录。

en: Enforce settings that prevent the agent from autonomously running targeted exploits and require human review for all agent actions. Visit antigravity.google/docs/strict-mode for details.
zh: 强制启用限制，防止代理自主运行针对性攻击，并要求人工审核所有代理操作。详情见 antigravity.google/docs/strict-mode。

en: Allow the agent to automatically view and edit files outside the current workspace. Use with caution: this gives the agent access to additional potentially-relevant information, but also allows the agent to access credential files, secrets, and other files outside of the workspace that could be targeted in prompt injection attacks or other exploits by malicious actors.
zh: 允许代理自动查看和编辑当前工作区之外的文件。请谨慎使用：代理可获取更多相关信息，也能访问工作区外的凭据、密钥等文件，这些文件可能成为提示注入或其他恶意攻击的目标。

en: Use the IDE's shell integration to detect and report terminal command execution. When disabled, the agent uses its own shell. Restart the application for this to take effect.
zh: 使用 IDE 的 Shell 集成检测并报告终端命令执行情况。关闭时代理使用自己的 Shell。重启应用后生效。

en:
Controls whether terminal commands require your approval before running.

Note: A change to this setting will only apply to new messages sent to the agent. In-progress responses will use the previous setting value.
zh:
控制运行终端命令前是否需要你批准。

注意：修改仅对之后发送的消息生效，正在生成的回复仍使用原设置。

en: The agent never asks for confirmation before executing terminal commands (except those in the Deny list). This provides the agent with the maximum ability to operate over long periods without intervention, but also has the highest risk of the agent executing an unsafe terminal command.
zh: 代理执行终端命令前不请求确认（拒绝列表中的命令除外）。这让代理可以长时间自主工作，但执行不安全命令的风险也最高。

en: Terminal commands automatically proceed inside the sandbox. A command that needs to leave the sandbox proceeds only if an agent judges it reversible, and otherwise requests review.
zh: 终端命令在沙箱内自动执行。需要离开沙箱的命令，仅在代理判断其可撤销时执行，否则请求审核。

en: The agent always asks for confirmation before executing terminal commands (except those in the Allow list).
zh: 代理执行终端命令前始终请求确认（允许列表中的命令除外）。

en: Terminal command automatically proceeds if the command runs inside the sandbox. Otherwise, it requests review.
zh: 沙箱内的终端命令自动执行，其他命令请求审核。

en:
When running commands, the agent will try to use this address, and fall back to the "connector.host.featureDefault" host if not defined.

Note: hosts set here with auto-run enabled will have internet access restricted soon.
zh:
运行命令时，代理优先使用此地址；未设置时使用“connector.host.featureDefault”主机。

注意：此处启用自动执行的主机即将受到互联网访问限制。

en: Specifies the agent's behavior when asking for review on artifacts, which are documents it creates to enable a richer conversation experience.
zh: 指定代理请求审核其生成文档时的行为。这些文档用于提供更丰富的对话体验。

en: The agent never asks for review. This maximizes the autonomy of the agent, but also has the highest risk of the agent operating over unsafe or injected artifact content.
zh: 代理从不请求审核。这能最大程度提高自主性，但处理不安全或被注入内容的文档时风险也最高。

en: Agent never asks for review. This maximizes the autonomy of the Agent, but also has the highest risk of the Agent operating over unsafe or injected Artifact content.
zh: 代理从不请求审核。这能最大程度提高自主性，但处理不安全或被注入内容的文档时风险也最高。

en: The agent always asks for review.
GCP Project ID for enterprise features.
zh: 企业功能使用的 GCP 项目 ID。

en: Allow Tab to view and edit the files in .gitignore. Use with caution if your .gitignore lists files containing credentials, secrets, or other sensitive information.

en: Let the agent use browser tools to open URLs, read web pages, and interact with browser content. This gives the agent access to important (and often critical) knowledge and methods of validation, but any browser integration does increase exposure to external malicious parties for security exploits.
zh: 允许代理使用浏览器工具打开网址、读取网页并与网页交互。这样可获取重要信息和验证方法，同时也会增加遭受外部恶意攻击的风险。

en: Give each Best of N fork a full clone of your workspace, including its local commit history. Choosing a winner then gives your workspace that fork's state, so the commits it made are kept. Forks take longer to create than the default CitC clone. See go/jetski-best-of-n.

en: Please describe the feature you'd like to see. The more detailed the requirements, the easier it will be for our team to incorporate your ideas. Some helpful information includes:
zh: 请描述你希望增加的功能。需求越具体，团队越容易采纳。建议提供：

en: What is missing in your workflow
zh: 当前工作流程缺少什么

en: What you would like to see to address this gap in your workflow
zh: 你希望如何补足工作流程中的不足

en: How this feature would help you and other users
zh: 该功能如何帮助你和其他用户

en: Please describe your auth or billing issue. More details will help our support team resolve your issue quicker. Some helpful information includes:
zh: 请描述登录或计费问题。提供更多细节有助于支持团队更快处理。建议提供：

en: What quota or feature is being incorrectly limited
zh: 哪些额度或功能受到错误限制

en: What functionality you expect your account tier to have available that is missing
zh: 你的账号套餐应有但缺失哪些功能

en: Any error messages seen when trying to log in
zh: 尝试登录时出现的错误信息

en: Use this form if you cannot connect to Remote Control. If your instance is already connected and you are experiencing issues in the browser, report directly from the Remote Control web page so that relevant logs are included. Some helpful information includes:
zh: 无法连接远程控制时请使用此表单。若已连接但浏览器中出现问题，请直接在远程控制网页反馈，以便附带相关日志。建议提供：

en: Whether it never connects or is intermittent/flaky
zh: 始终无法连接还是连接不稳定

en: Did restarting the desktop app help?
zh: 重启桌面应用是否有效

en: For any feedback that does not fit into the above categories.
zh: 用于不属于以上分类的其他反馈。

en: Describe the feature you would like to see...
Describe your auth or billing issue...
Please list the steps to reproduce the issue
zh: 请列出问题的复现步骤
截图大小必须小于 10 MB
附加 Antigravity 服务器日志

en: Attaching logs requires an email address
zh: 附加日志需要邮箱地址

en: Thank you! Your feedback has been submitted successfully.
An error occurred while submitting your feedback. Please try again.
zh: 提交反馈时出错，请重试。

en: We recommend attaching logs. Attaching logs will help the Antigravity team act on and prioritize your feedback.
zh: 建议附加日志，以帮助 Antigravity 团队处理反馈并确定优先级。

en: to ask for content changes for legal reasons.
zh: 以法律原因请求修改内容。

en: You can upgrade to a Google AI Ultra plan to receive higher rate limits.
zh: 升级至 Google AI Ultra 套餐可获得更高的使用限额。
管理 Antigravity 应用设置。

en: When toggled on, Antigravity will use your AI credits to fulfill model requests once you're out of model quota. Antigravity will always use your model quota first before using AI credits.
zh: 开启后，模型额度用尽时 Antigravity 会使用 AI 点数完成模型请求。Antigravity 始终优先使用模型额度，再使用 AI 点数。

en: When toggled on, Antigravity collects usage data to help Google enhance performance and features.
zh: 开启后，Antigravity 收集使用数据，以帮助 Google 改进性能和功能。

en: Receive product updates, tips, and promotions from Google Antigravity via email.
zh: 通过邮件接收 Google Antigravity 的产品更新、提示和推广信息。

en: Agent settings and permissions for conversations outside of projects.
zh: 不属于项目的对话所使用的代理设置和权限。

en: Agent settings and permissions for conversations outside of workspaces.
zh: 不属于工作区的对话所使用的代理设置和权限。

en: Manage project resources, agent settings, and permissions.
zh: 管理项目资源、代理设置和权限。

en: Manage project folders, agent settings, and permissions.
zh: 管理项目文件夹、代理设置和权限。

en: Manage workspace resources, agent settings, and permissions.
zh: 管理工作区资源、代理设置和权限。

en: Manage workspace folders, agent settings, and permissions.
zh: 管理工作区文件夹、代理设置和权限。

en: The agent auto-executes commands matched by an allow list entry. For Unix shells, an allow list entry matches a command if its space-separated tokens form a prefix of the command's tokens. For PowerShell, the entry tokens may match any contiguous subsequence of the command tokens.
zh: 代理自动执行匹配允许列表条目的命令。对于 Unix Shell，允许条目按空格分隔的词元必须匹配命令词元的前缀；对于 PowerShell，条目词元可以匹配命令词元的任意连续片段。

en: The agent asks for permission before executing commands matched by a deny list entry. The deny list follows the same matching rules as the allow list and takes precedence over the allow list.
zh: 代理执行匹配拒绝列表条目的命令前请求许可。拒绝列表使用与允许列表相同的匹配规则，且优先于允许列表。
